ds:2704fba9566736ee.source: [THOSE NUTS HAVE A SUPER HARD SHELL ON THEM]

ds:eedaf681bd57def6.source: [BUT EATING THEM SHOULD INCREASE YOUR DEFENSE!]
ds:eedaf681bd57def6.translation: [不过吃下去应该能提升你的防御力！]

ds:adc61025a94feee9.source: [NOT ONLY WILL THAT HEAL A BIT OF YOUR VITALITY]

ds:30d9569c674f856c.source: [BUT IT'LL ALSO INCREASE YOUR LUK STAT! LUCKY!]
ds:30d9569c674f856c.translation: [还能提升你的幸运属性！真幸运！]

ds:afc92a9446b1f969.source: [THAT'S A STRANGE LOOKING COOKIE YOU GOT THERE!]
ds:afc92a9446b1f969.translation: [你那块饼干看起来可真奇怪！]

ds:1147688085ab1b33.source: [BUT WHO KNOWS WHAT SORT OF FORTUNE NOTE IS WITHIN]
ds:1147688085ab1b33.translation: [不过，谁知道里面藏着什么运势签呢？]

ds:0b9d730464939ce4.source: [IT'S BOUND TO BRING YOU GOOD LUCK AFTER EATING, HEH!]

ds:a6bc8e2b44ecb467.source: [THAT'S A BOTTLE OF CREAM, NO CLUE WHY THE KOBO HAD IT]
ds:a6bc8e2b44ecb467.translation: [那是瓶奶油，不知道那只狗头人为什么带着，]

ds:772d87476c7625e0.source: [BUT IF IT'S LASTED THIS LONG BEING CARRIED AROUND]
ds:772d87476c7625e0.translation: [不过要是带在身上这么久都没坏，]

ds:449cbff08a10b78f.source: [IT WON'T HURT YOU TO DRINK IT DOWN!]

ds:54d60f799889993b.source: [IN FACT, MAYBE IT'LL EVEN MAKE YOU STRONGER!]
ds:54d60f799889993b.translation: [说不定还会让你变得更强呢！]

ds:1e592a4b6a01978d.translation: [我是说，反正也不会有什么坏处，对吧？]

ds:564cab51009aae9a.source: [JUST DON'T RUN INTO LAVA AFTER CHUGGING IT...]
ds:564cab51009aae9a.translation: [只是灌下去之后别往熔岩里跑……]

ds:e3944ce1b6aa0469.source: [HEY, A LIL BIT OF NOSTALGIA NEVER HURT ANYONE, RIGHT?]
ds:e3944ce1b6aa0469.translation: [嘿，偶尔怀旧一下又没什么坏处，对吧？]

ds:17b032e70530d638.source: [THAT'LL LET YOU FOCUS A BIT MORE WHILE IN BATTLE]
ds:17b032e70530d638.translation: [它能让你在战斗时更专注一些，]

ds:49b86bae4d3b5ca4.source: [NO KUNG FU ACTION ON THIS MISSION!]
ds:49b86bae4d3b5ca4.translation: [这次任务可不许你大耍功夫！]

ds:b5a2c1f3b06c09ec.source: [IT ALWAYS MADE ME FEEL LIKE A FIGHTER WHEN I WORE MINE]
ds:b5a2c1f3b06c09ec.translation: [我穿上自己的那套时，总觉得自己像个格斗家。]

ds:33b1f4c422b32105.source: [EVEN IF IT MAKES YOU FEEL LIKE A FIGHTER AGAIN!]
ds:33b1f4c422b32105.translation: [就算它又让你觉得自己是个格斗家也一样！]

ds:f480db2b52c914f7.source: [HEY, AS LONG AS IT DOESN'T EXPLODE ON ME!]
ds:f480db2b52c914f7.translation: [嘿，只要别在我手里炸掉就行！]

ds:496c1c53d638978e.source: [YEAH YOU CAN TAKE THAT RISK, NOT ME...]
ds:496c1c53d638978e.translation: [行，你可以去冒这个险，我可不干……]

ds:f0bd21e184e02c7d.source: [OKAY YOU'RE GETTING MORE INTO THIS THAN ME, NEVERMIND...]

ds:fc26378e09cc0de0.source: [BUT STILL IN ONE PIECE! AND THAT'S WHAT COUNTS!]
ds:fc26378e09cc0de0.translation: [不过还完整无缺！这才是最重要的！]

ds:308fe51b772ee7d6.source: [DON'T FORGET TO EQUIP NEW GEAR FROM YOUR P.A.W MENU]

ds:09c3c3a5cbcbfe57.source: [OR YOU WON'T BE ABLE TO APPRECIATE THE HIGHER STATS!]
ds:09c3c3a5cbcbfe57.translation: [不然你可享受不到提升的属性！]

ds:46810d18c1b70730.source: [THOSE ARE DEFINITELY A COSTUME PIECE, BUT]

ds:81c45253e336b9e1.source: [LOOK I'M NOT ONE TO COMMENT ON THIS SORTA STUFF, BUT...]
ds:81c45253e336b9e1.translation: [听着，我一般不评论这种东西，不过……]

ds:332f6c61538fa380.source: [NOT SURE WHO WOULD LEAVE AROUND SOMETHING LIKE THAT]
ds:332f6c61538fa380.translation: [不知道谁会把那种东西随手丢着，]

ds:e8881b8228ff063e.source: [CONSIDERING THAT SCALE SUITS CAN COST THOUSANDS OF LECT]
ds:e8881b8228ff063e.translation: [毕竟一套鳞装可能要花上几千Lect，]

ds:283b74ebbeb9ec14.source: [BUT IF YOU'RE COMFORTABLE PUTTING IT ON, GO FOR IT!]
ds:283b74ebbeb9ec14.translation: [不过你要是穿着舒服，那就穿吧！]

ds:37d57414984eb876.source: [WHAT'D YOU SEE, A GHOST OR MAYBE A KOBOLD OR-]
ds:37d57414984eb876.translation: [你看见什么了，鬼，还是狗头人，还——]

ds:e3d925dd4104777c.source: [YEAH, SAID HE GOT IN TOUCH WITH A SIDE OF HIMSELF THAT]
ds:e3d925dd4104777c.translation: [是啊，他说自己发现了自身的另一面，那一面]

ds:95c137d7efc541ad.source: [THERE'S NO WAY HIS STORY WOULD BE REAL!]
ds:95c137d7efc541ad.translation: [他那个故事怎么可能是真的！]

ds:f30488f13c791e54.source: [GOOD JOB FINDING A VITAMIN! CHOMP ONE OF THOSE]
ds:f30488f13c791e54.translation: [找到维生素了，干得好！吃上一颗，]

ds:ee99e2d615cb130f.source: [THEY'LL LET YOU LEARN A BIT MORE ABOUT CREATURES]
ds:ee99e2d615cb130f.translation: [它们能让你更了解这些生物，]

ds:b1243cf258eca8c9.source: [WHILE ALSO LETTING YOU KNOW IF THEY DROP ANY LOOT!]
ds:b1243cf258eca8c9.translation: [也能告诉你它们会不会掉落战利品！]

ds:18d4686cbc6b2df2.source: Do you want a treat, girl? Do ya?
ds:18d4686cbc6b2df2.translation: 想吃点零食吗，小姑娘？想不想呀？

ds:fafc8fbb02b93b0a.source: QUICK, UNLOCK THIS CELL! YOU HAVE A KEY, RIGHT...?
ds:fafc8fbb02b93b0a.translation: 快，把牢门打开！你有钥匙，对吧……？

ds:2f66d3694d07570e.source: YOU CAN'T OPEN THAT DOOR WITH YOUR BARE HANDS!
ds:2f66d3694d07570e.translation: 你徒手可打不开那扇门！

ds:ddc7d38f8fa494ae.source: I'M ALREADY RESCUED, YIFFAI! BUT THANK YOU!
ds:ddc7d38f8fa494ae.translation: 我已经得救了，伊法伊！不过还是谢谢你！

ds:3ff6029db423b80e.source: SOME CREEPY ROBED CANINE LOCKED ME UP IN HERE!
ds:3ff6029db423b80e.translation: 有个穿长袍的怪犬把我关在这里了！

ds:6476a5fa8a7ac513.source: I might have gotten myself in a sliight bit of trouble...
ds:6476a5fa8a7ac513.translation: 我好像给自己惹了那么一——点小麻烦……

ds:e22dd2e0d4de6bc7.source: Th-thanks pal! Good luck rescuing the others!
ds:e22dd2e0d4de6bc7.translation: 谢、谢谢你，伙计！祝你救其他人时一切顺利！

ds:ad9043249407be03.source: I could probably dig my way out of here after a couple of years...
ds:ad9043249407be03.translation: 再挖上几年，我大概就能挖出去了……

ds:d0cacf8be4fd9cba.source: ...unless you happen to find a key somewhere?
ds:d0cacf8be4fd9cba.translation: ……除非你碰巧能在什么地方找到把钥匙？

ds:a540f41746d394fd.source: I'm like, fine now. Just some scuffs and a bruised ego, that's all!
ds:a540f41746d394fd.translation: 我现在没事啦。就是擦破点皮，自尊心受了点伤，仅此而已！

ds:20620cd1a5b3506b.source: I was totally conquering this planet before they locked me up, I swear!
ds:20620cd1a5b3506b.translation: 我发誓，被关起来之前，我都快征服这颗星球了！

ds:d404c5cd7def0533.source: Where are you going?! You're supposed to mount a heroic rescue, you know!
ds:d404c5cd7def0533.translation: 你要去哪儿？！你该来场英雄救援才对啊！

ds:ec57817628add999.source: Who's a good boy? I am! But you wanna help...?
ds:ec57817628add999.translation: 谁是乖孩子？是我！不过，你想帮忙吗……？

ds:8a48aa708ac2c10a.source: Lead your master back here, please!
ds:8a48aa708ac2c10a.translation: 请把你的主人带到这里来！

ds:973c44d559d0e3fe.source: No way...! I'm never gonna get out of here at this rate!
ds:973c44d559d0e3fe.translation: 不会吧……！这样下去，我永远都出不去了！

ds:b80dba5f6e954f79.source: I've tried everything to break that barrier, but it's no good!
ds:b80dba5f6e954f79.translation: 我什么办法都试过了，就是打不破那道屏障！

ds:b618da7f4124c424.source: Maybe you could disrupt it with a tazer strike...?
ds:b618da7f4124c424.translation: 也许你用电击器打一下，就能扰乱它……？

ds:7ae94e055e8d56ed.source: Thanks lad. I'll head back to the hangar in a little while.
ds:7ae94e055e8d56ed.translation: 谢谢，小伙子。我过一会儿就回机库。

ds:d86b2ec045ec5453.source: I was investigating this room for clues, when someone turned the barrier on...
ds:d86b2ec045ec5453.translation: 我正在这个房间里找线索，不知谁就把屏障打开了……

ds:76650f1ceeb1a4d5.source: Trapped like a kit, how amateurish...
ds:76650f1ceeb1a4d5.translation: 像只小猫一样被困住，真不专业……

ds:f6a95d29eee3fc10.source: I'll be sure not to go poking my nose where it doesn't belong, next time!
ds:f6a95d29eee3fc10.translation: 下次我一定不会再把鼻子伸进不该伸的地方了！

ds:cffe160900e92022.source: I guess I'm not getting rescued today? O-okay, well... I'll be waiting.
ds:cffe160900e92022.translation: 看来今天是没人来救我了？好、好吧，那……我会等着。

ds:b7d275bcc76a3dd2.source: I... I think I can take it from here.
ds:b7d275bcc76a3dd2.translation: 我……我想接下来我自己能行了。

ds:7a626c5e0d98ea3c.source: I thought you were a dwarf at first. They aren't very nice!
ds:7a626c5e0d98ea3c.translation: 我一开始还以为你是矮人。他们可不怎么友善！

ds:3c896be87a4349e8.source: You know, I think I've had enough of the mines!
ds:3c896be87a4349e8.translation: 说真的，我已经受够矿井了！

ds:f62adfae4ef989c1.source: Oh, hey! I was just about to break out of here!
ds:f62adfae4ef989c1.translation: 哦，嗨！我正要从这里逃出去呢！

ds:e1b3ca57ed8b87a9.source: Good boy! Come back with your master!
ds:e1b3ca57ed8b87a9.translation: 乖孩子！带你的主人回来！

ds:0c24d92caadf82e7.source: It's not like I *need* your help... well, probably not.
ds:0c24d92caadf82e7.translation: 我又不是*需要*你帮忙……好吧，大概不需要。

ds:9b102347f313d586.source: I've just about got this door open.
ds:9b102347f313d586.translation: 我就快把这扇门弄开了。

ds:4d21475eb1501efd.source: But if you wanna try to break it down, I guess I can't complain...
ds:4d21475eb1501efd.translation: 不过你要想试着把门砸开，我也没什么好抱怨的……

ds:649b28f344badc8e.source: I think I can handle this from here.
ds:649b28f344badc8e.translation: 接下来我想自己能搞定了。

ds:85687f06b67a8fdd.source: I'm - hmf - trying to access the electronics for this door.
ds:85687f06b67a8fdd.translation: 我在——哼——想办法接上这扇门的电子线路。

ds:4d5ff00c5de1ce8f.source: But it's a little tougher than I expected.
ds:4d5ff00c5de1ce8f.translation: 不过比我想的难了一点。

ds:7b0848433e7275be.source: Hmm... if I could have just gotten into that panel...
ds:7b0848433e7275be.translation: 嗯……要是能打开那个面板就好了……

ds:a1198ac6e7f9a23c.source: Wow, *good job*. Want me to ask command to give you a gold star?
ds:a1198ac6e7f9a23c.translation: 哇，*真能干*。要不要我请指挥部给你颁颗小金星？

ds:6f261647b11592b4.source: By the time I came to, they'd locked me up in here. The cowards!
ds:6f261647b11592b4.translation: 等我醒过来，他们就已经把我关在这里了。一群胆小鬼！

ds:f9818b318ea7e9c9.source: H-howdy friend! I'd give ya a warm welcome, but I'm awful cooped up!
ds:f9818b318ea7e9c9.translation: 你、你好啊，朋友！我倒想热情欢迎你，可这里实在太挤了！

ds:7ff0113ea63adfd4.source: P-please! I'm askin' ya real nice-like!
ds:7ff0113ea63adfd4.translation: 拜、拜托！我都这么客客气气地求你了！

ds:32c498e75a8c1498.source: Now why would someone go lockin' up an innocent tod like me?
ds:32c498e75a8c1498.translation: 到底谁会把我这么无辜的公狐狸关起来啊？

ds:65980fe3e6ddf7e8.source: Oh hi there! I'm not really in trouble, it just looks like it!
ds:65980fe3e6ddf7e8.translation: 哦，你好！我其实没遇上麻烦，只是看起来像而已！

ds:e01f4c5b1dae221b.source: Just wait 'til I find my tazer again, those elves won't know what hit 'em!
ds:e01f4c5b1dae221b.translation: 等我找回电击器，那些精灵连自己怎么挨打的都不会知道！

ds:bee6f040ff587c1a.source: I'll break out of here myself!

ds:11723a7a05fc2661.source: Do you wanna keep me company while I think of how to break outta here, boy?
ds:11723a7a05fc2661.translation: 小伙子，要不要陪陪我，等我想出逃出去的办法？

ds:70f164fc4d1dcec4.source: Right. You might as well save your strength for someone who needs it!
ds:70f164fc4d1dcec4.translation: 对嘛。还是把力气留给真正需要帮助的人吧！

ds:c6df7821af8d88f1.source: I guess if you *really* want to help...
ds:c6df7821af8d88f1.translation: 我想，要是你*真的*那么想帮忙……

ds:84244c5253331cd3.source: Well, thanks. This'll make my conquest of the elves even easier!
ds:84244c5253331cd3.translation: 好吧，谢谢。这样征服精灵就更容易了！

ds:e170a72f43de58ea.source: I was single-pawwedly conquering the elven empire here.
ds:e170a72f43de58ea.translation: 我本来正在单爪征服这里的精灵帝国。

ds:a2ffa6d5c5c4f522.source: But I hit a little setback. Nothing for a trainee like you to worry over!
ds:a2ffa6d5c5c4f522.translation: 不过遇到了一点挫折。用不着你这样的见习生操心！

ds:05d406087d7d0b07.source: Getting the best of these Sceafyan elves is a real workout!
ds:05d406087d7d0b07.translation: 要压过这些斯凯菲亚精灵，还真挺费劲！

ds:21888c7bcb7c6728.source: But don't worry about me, trainee. I'll be fine.
ds:21888c7bcb7c6728.translation: 不过别担心我，见习生。我会没事的。

ds:ee73572e2d89158d.source: Take your time... us senior agents know how to keep our cool.
ds:ee73572e2d89158d.translation: 慢慢来……我们这些资深特工，最懂得保持冷静。

ds:40bc156fa25a3a8d.source: Why don't you run along and fetch someone who can let me out of here?
ds:40bc156fa25a3a8d.translation: 不如你去找个能放我出去的人回来？

ds:e29335cd2ec8f932.source: Are you playing around or something? Cut it out!

ds:1c7e969e67e8e496.source: There! We make a great team, with you doing all the work, haha!
ds:1c7e969e67e8e496.translation: 瞧！我们真是绝佳搭档，活儿全让你干了，哈哈！

ds:82e0f4ee5ce7e274.source: There's no way to get this lock open without a key. Believe me, I've tried.
ds:82e0f4ee5ce7e274.translation: 没有钥匙就打不开这把锁。相信我，我试过了。

ds:01987393c8c7a21a.source: The lock's open. Maybe go find someone else to rescue...?
ds:01987393c8c7a21a.translation: 锁已经开了。不如去找其他人救……？

ds:6770cd931e66685a.source: Really... I'm a pretty cool cat. No rush on the rescue.
ds:6770cd931e66685a.translation: 真的……我可是只淡定的猫。救援不着急。

ds:c3462eb54d6276a4.source: If you bust me out of here, I'll show you a few tricks, haha!
ds:c3462eb54d6276a4.translation: 你要是把我弄出去，我就教你几招，哈哈！

ds:65ff32200b131981.source: Lot more loot in it than being a cosmo agent, hen-heh...
ds:65ff32200b131981.translation: 比当宇宙特工能捞到的好处多多了，嘿嘿……

ds:1a3aa5b34fd3513e.source: [BUT NO MATTER! I'M YOUR MAIN LIAISON FOR THIS SORTIE]
ds:1a3aa5b34fd3513e.translation: [不过没关系！这次行动由我担任你的主要联络员。]

ds:3ccceda5da1ee249.source: [THE SATELLITE IS SENDING A CONSTANT STREAM OF YOUR]
ds:3ccceda5da1ee249.translation: [卫星正在源源不断地传来你的]

ds:6a5d3aec6276f594.source: [GOOD JOB SHOWING THAT BRUTE WHAT FOR, YIFFAI!]
ds:6a5d3aec6276f594.translation: [干得好，伊法伊，给了那蛮横的大块头一点颜色看看！]

ds:dc14dcb4d2c0a97b.source: [MANAGED TO HOLD YOUR OWN, EH YIFFAI?]

ds:1082e26c65195b0f.source: [HE SEEMED OKAY, JUST A LITTLE ROUGHED UP.]
ds:1082e26c65195b0f.translation: [他看起来没什么大碍，只是受了点伤。]

ds:ad5d63e566731da0.source: [THAT'S RIGHT BUDDY BOY, THANKS TO THE LOCAL SATELLITE]
ds:ad5d63e566731da0.translation: [没错，小伙子，多亏了附近的卫星，]

ds:ed03c3a0fc85e398.source: [SO THAT MEANS I CAN GO AFTER THOSE DARN SHIPS THA-]
ds:ed03c3a0fc85e398.translation: [那就是说，我可以去追那些该死的飞船——]

ds:100677064ac1764c.source: [YOU'RE RIGHT, I SHOULD DEFINITELY COLLECT 'EM ALL!]
ds:100677064ac1764c.translation: [你说得对，我一定得把它们全收集齐！]

ds:bfc97215eff65681.source: [I'M NOT JOKING! WHAT DATA DID HQ PICK UP JUST NOW?]
ds:bfc97215eff65681.translation: [我没开玩笑！总部刚才收到了什么数据？]

ds:3d9be7c3fb719d34.source: [THE SATELLITE STOPPED TRANSMITTING DATA UNTIL JUST NOW]
ds:3d9be7c3fb719d34.translation: [那颗卫星直到刚才才恢复数据传输。]

ds:5ae682eec2535e85.source: [NO DOUBT ABOUT IT. I'D RECOGNIZE HER ANYWHERE.]
ds:5ae682eec2535e85.translation: [绝对没错。她在哪儿我都认得出来。]

ds:4d453351354f3704.source: [WE HERE AT HQ NEED YOU TO SETTLE A BET.]
ds:4d453351354f3704.translation: [我们总部这边需要你来裁定一个赌局。]

ds:4e1bb2d94d1198c5.source: [TOMCAT IS SAYING THAT YOU JUST PICKED UP WHAT SEEMS TO B-]
ds:4e1bb2d94d1198c5.translation: [汤姆猫说你刚捡到的东西好像是——]

ds:e4e67a81aa5b12b7.source: [YOU JUST GOT YOUR HANDS ON A DRESS, DIDN'T YOU PUP?]
ds:e4e67a81aa5b12b7.translation: [你刚弄到了一条连衣裙，对不对，小狗崽？]

ds:f53adfd698dc1c30.source: [THE ELF QUEEN JUST GAVE YOU A DRESS??]
ds:f53adfd698dc1c30.translation: [精灵女王刚送了你一条连衣裙？？]

ds:9e83ad1156cdda6f.source: [YOU MIIIIGHT WANT TO TRY IT ON.]

ds:d15a6d1679865dd5.source: [YOU SERIOUS? YOU'RE NOT JUST TRYING GET ME TO WEAR A-]
ds:d15a6d1679865dd5.translation: [你认真的？不是想骗我穿上一条——]

ds:90cd50283759452a.source: [COMPLETELY 100% SERIOUS! I SWEAR ON PPP HONOR!]

ds:6392abf3a7fd2849.source: [YEAH, YOU DO THAT WHILE I PAY UP OVER HERE.]
ds:6392abf3a7fd2849.translation: [行，你去试吧，我在这边付赌钱。]

ds:6f9c0b4595e6c6f7.source: [DON'T WORRY GUYS, I THINK I CAN HANDLE IT!]

ds:b725f32f8500547d.source: [THEY'RE AN AGGRESS- IVE BREED THAT MAY HAVE MISTAKEN YOU]
ds:b725f32f8500547d.translation: [它们是个好斗的种类，可能把你错认成了]

ds:5be4d6374e8ad4a1.source: [SO THEY COULD BE TRYING TO MAKE SURE YOU KNOW YOUR PLACE]

ds:20b62b07b5f8100a.source: [DON'T WORRY YIFFAI, YOU ARE STILL 100% DOG.]

ds:6e0ca3c0890caa57.source: [WE LOST CONTACT WITH 2 AGENTS IN THAT SECTOR]

ds:67984ac467f3abbc.source: [HOPE HE FINDS IT AGAIN ONCE HE COMES AROUND, THAT PUNK!]
